doc: value[i,j] = data[i,j] * weight_scale, weight scale only -- no activation scale role at all. ComfyUI's scaled_fp8 emits this for the H3 DiT's `mlp.fc2` while emitting the input_scale variant for `out_proj`/`qkv_proj`/`mlp.fc1` in the same file. Same narrowing rule as the sibling variant: the scale lands in the logical dtype before the multiply.
